method: Compared full canonical Nursing question stem, choices, answer key, explanation, subject/concept metadata with the selected lesson section body, concept ID, registered references, and Nursing production eligibility. Exact link decisions are structural proposals only; independent academic review remains pending. Every accepted candidate now includes a concise stem-to-section comparison; these notes explain technical mapping only and do not imply academic approval. Seven additional close-variant cohort items were compared in full; each exact fit is linked to the same narrowly scoped section, and all remain independent-review pending.

summary.source_only_relationships_retained: Prior source-only rows remain unless the same material/question association gained a defensible exact section; original source_ids are preserved and section sources appended.
